_source: Comansa 16CM260-10t spec sheet CM-DS-201810-009 / vDS201810009, OCR/vision extraction from PDF supplied 2026-05-29
_note: Manufacturer/spec-sheet data only. The spec page states required power of 110kVA with HFU2-37-25 hoist and 126kVA with HFU2-45-25 hoist at 400V 3ph 50Hz. Use 126kVA as the conservative electrical requirement for the 16CM260-10 unless the hoist variant is confirmed as HFU2-37-25. Recommend 150kVA prime-rated generator minimum; allow 200kVA where shared loads, long cable runs or site power quality are uncertain.

saddle_cranes.start_method: VFD / frequency-controlled mechanisms per spec page
saddle_cranes.source_detail: Spec page shows Required power: HFU2-37-25 = 110kVA, HFU2-45-25 = 126kVA; trolley TFU-7.5 = 7.5kW; slewing SFU-7.5 = 2x7.5kW; 400V 3ph 50Hz.
saddle_cranes._generator_guidance: 150kVA prime-rated generator minimum for crane-only feed; 200kVA if shared, long cable run, voltage-dip risk or uncertain site conditions.
